questions.question: At which ground did Refilwe Moncho record their career-best bowling figures (2-11, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Centurion Park, against Titans on 2025/11/09.

questions.question: At Wanderers, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Kgomotso Rapoo holds it with 15, a joint record shared with Sarah Nettleton.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Cobras?
How many 50+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Susan Benade) and #2 (Cri-Zelda Brits) half-century makers (List A) in the 07/08 season?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade: 5 — Cri-Zelda Brits: 4 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: Who has scored the most ducks for the South African Women's team in ODI's?
At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 533, against Kei on 2011/01/29.
